edits.before: - Tristana Rocket Jump: matchup-defining — Her engage AND escape in one button — once spent she is the lane’s most catchable carry. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Beat Drop for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Rocket Jump is down 22s early, 14s maxed — once spent she's the lane's most catchable carry; step up only then. - Her R (100s CD) executes at combo's end. - Budget your own E Beat Drop for emergencies, R for opportunities.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: W shields, then heals once already shielded — cast it before she jumps in so both procs land before her burst does.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Her E detonation and R knockback punish you standing forward — let your support eat the jump-in, not you.
